blocks.value: Granite Hill School of Advanced Research

The doctoral programme in Environmental Science trains researchers to investigate environmental systems and produce original scholarly work. Study proceeds in four stages: coursework, candidacy, independent research, and a dissertation defended before an examining committee.
On completion of the programme, the candidate will be able to:
Design and carry out independent research on a significant environmental science
Apply advanced theory, field, laboratory, and quantitative methods appropriate to the
Produce an original contribution to knowledge in environmental science, suitable for
Evaluate environmental evidence, uncertainty, and the implications of research for policy
Closed written papers plus an oral examination
Written research proposal and oral defense.
